brief.must_read_as: a human hand, at phone size, in each grip and reach below
brief.seen_at: large: 25-40% of frame height, usually with the object it holds in frame
moving_parts: armature with independent finger and thumb joints
states: gripping a lever or door handle
reaching and touching a car door
fist with the thumb on the index finger (knuckle-cracking family)
brief.style_notes: Stylised skin material, no real skin texture. A NEW asset: `human-hand` stays as sealed because finished productions depend on its hash (rule d).

commission.trigger: both: five undrawn bank entries, and two productions that paid for the missing rig
evidence: banked rank 2 (hand on the cabin door handle)
banked rank 5 (driver's hands on the wheel)
banked rank 9 (hand on the car door)
reserve 25 (hand on the knife and tomato)
reserve 27 (passengers' hands fumbling with oxygen masks)
improvisation_paid: 006: `human-hand` is one fixed pose with no rig, so the video was staged around fingers that cannot bend
013 (returned 2026-11-09): carried a rig build as an in-production fallback and failed on the finger-joint cutaway
commission.replaces: the fixed-pose `human-hand`, which cannot grip, reach or fumble
